svg.title: Achraf Lakdim, security engineer in training
svg.desc: I build detection pipelines, investigate what they catch, and automate the repetitive parts. 2024-07: Ministry of Digital Transition, Data-center network security and monitoring. 2025-07: Huawei, Built NAV, a network mapping and scanning app. 2026-02: Sofrecom (Orange Group), Open-source SOC/SOAR proof of concept. 2026-09: Lumiplan, SIEM migration, vulnerability management, ISO 27001. now: Home lab, Purple-team lab, from alert to forensic report.
